description: Add a soft dark vignette around the edges of any photo with an adjustable strength slider.

faqs.a: A radial gradient that stays transparent in the center and darkens toward the corners — strength controls how dark and how far in it reaches.
Yes — drag the strength slider and watch the preview update live.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the strength slider to preview the vignette.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Vignette Adder
